items.title: Review Delay May Give Vera Therapeutics Stock More Time To Build TRUTAKNA Share
items.summary: The FDA recently extended the review of Vertex Pharmaceuticals' IgA nephropathy drug povetacicept by three months after classifying a filing as a major amendment, which delays a final decision until February 28, 2027. This delay leaves Vera Therapeutics' already approved IgA nephropathy treatment TRUTAKNA facing fewer near term direct rivals and gives the business more room to focus on physician adoption and patient conversion. items.title: Vertex Pharma falls after FDA extends review of kidney disease drug
items.summary: Nov 27 (Reuters) - Vertex Pharmaceuticals shares slipped 6% on Friday after the US health regulator delayed its decision ‌on the company's experimental kidney disease drug until next year, pushing ‌back its entry into the increasingly competitive market. The US Food and Drug Administration late ​on Wednesday extended its review of povetacicept, developed to treat immunoglobulin A nephropathy — a chronic disease caused by the buildup of immune antibodies in the kidneys.

items.title: Vertex shares drop after FDA delays kidney drug decision
items.summary: Investing.com -- Vertex Pharmaceuticals shares fell 7% Friday morning in New York after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration pushed back its decision on the company's chronic kidney disease treatment by up to three months.
